evidence.ACL: There is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.
evidence.MCL: There is grade II ligamentous sprain (partial tear) of the medial collateral ligament, at mid substance (deep and superficial fibers).
evidence.Medial Meniscus: there is small longitudinal tear at the periphery posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: there is horizontal tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury.
evidence.Effusion: Some amount of left knee effusion is present.
evidence.Contusion: There is bone bruise at posteromedial, posterolateral tibial plateaus and mid weight-baring lateral femoral condyle.
evidence.Fracture: There is bone bruise at posteromedial, posterolateral tibial plateaus and mid weight-baring lateral femoral condyle.
